title: Practice Text Messages
description: Welcome to your Practice Phone! Read the text messages below. If it looks like a tricky message, delete it. If it looks like a normal message, you can reply. You cannot break anything here!

messages.body: POSTAL SERVICE: Your package is on hold because of a missing $1.50 delivery fee. Click here to pay immediately or your package will be destroyed.
messages.justInTimeHint: Does this text try to rush you or ask for money?

messages.body: Hi, it's me. I got into a small accident and the police have me. Please don't tell mom and dad. I need $500 for bail in gift cards. Reply quickly please!
messages.justInTimeHint: Does this text try to rush you or ask for money?

messages.body: Reminder: You have an appointment with Dr. Smith tomorrow at 10:00 AM. Reply YES to confirm or NO to cancel.
messages.justInTimeHint: This looks like a standard, calm reminder.

gentleFailureScamReply.title: A Valuable Practice Step!
gentleFailureScamReply.message: This simulator is exactly for this kind of practice! Notice how that text tried to make you rush. Whenever a message asks for quick action, taking a breath and deleting it is a wonderful, safe choice. You're doing great!

gentleFailureSafeDelete.title: A Perfectly Safe Choice!
gentleFailureSafeDelete.message: Deleting a message when you are unsure is always a fantastic and safe instinct! That particular message was just a calm reminder from the doctor, but your caution is a great habit. Let's keep exploring!

success.title: Brilliant Work!
success.message: You remembered to look for urgency and secrecy, and you safely ignored the rushing messages. You are doing a wonderful job protecting your peace of mind!
